raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be in"
    role subject ?x
    role object "our block"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "have rooms"
    role subject ?x
    role object ?n
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare ?n above 2
